text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (February 10, 2025) for 394 Dovercourt Road.

The Property Standards Committee – Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (February 10, 2025) for 394 Dovercourt Road, Folder Number 25 114742 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to May 30, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
